Chapter 403: Chapter 15 Guidance and Planning (Please Subscribe)

“What does Lord Mo Li mean?”

Feng Yu, seeing Mo Li turn away without hesitation, felt a sense of foreboding.

In terms of background, he was far inferior to Mo Li, coming from a power that had once produced a Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warrior.

However, having been defined as a ‘Golden Pattern’, Feng Yu was naturally not foolish. He knew that among the Thirteen Peak Masters, the talent and innate abilities were the strongest and most favored by the Chikun Star Lord.

After all, he was a junior disciple.

But what of it?

...

No matter how strong the innate talent, it has no direct connection with whether one would teach a disciple.

In the many alliances of human civilization’s stars, there were numerous invincible existences at the Eighth Layer, but the Chikun Star Lord was unique because he excelled at mentoring disciples.

The Great Peak Master’s innate talent was not as good as that of the Shisan Peak Master, but after all, he had been with the Star Lord the longest and had now stepped into the Eighth Layer. He would soon preside over a Star Domain and become a new Star Lord.

His choice of the Great Peak Master might be surpassed by the Shisan Peak Master after a long period, but at least before that long period, his, Feng Yu’s, choice was definitely not wrong.

However, Feng Yu’s thoughts began to waver when he saw Mo Li’s tone when asking him the question and the look of astonishment when he learned of his choice of the Great Peak Master.

Mo Li, being a Red Patternn Examiner and with a mysterious and enormous background, surely knew many things that he himself was unaware of.

Could it be that he had chosen wrongly with such a reaction from the other party?

Feng Yu began to doubt himself.

He looked at the ‘one’ on his sleeve cuff.

This number was the mark of the thirteen Peak Masters; once it appeared, it could not be changed.

Perhaps a Red Pattern Examiners could change it, but he, merely a Golden Pattern Challenger, definitely had no such possibility.

After all, it involved the dignity of the thirteen Peak Masters,

Before entering those thirteen grand doors, the challengers could make their own choices,

but once they entered, it was already decided.

“I don’t believe I made the wrong choice.”

“That Shisan Peak Master, no matter how monstrous his talent, will take a great deal of time to step into the Eighth Layer, thousands or even tens of thousands of years.”

“Before then, my choice is correct.”

“Even a strong Seventh Rank is still a Seventh Rank; it can’t compare to an Eighth Layer.”

Feng Yu steadied his mind, thinking that Mo Li did this deliberately to shake his mental state.

…

Half a day later.

Feng Yu, along with many other challengers, entered the first mountain peak to meet the Great Peak Master.

“Greetings, Peak Master.”

Dozens of Evolvers respectfully saluted the Great Peak Master.

“Rise.”

The Great Peak Master was casually indifferent.

Among these challengers, only that Red Pattern could catch his eye more than once, but as for Golden Patterns? Being chosen to join the first mountain peak, they were essentially all Golden Patterns.

Golden Pattern Challengers were unparalleled geniuses dominating a planet in the outside world, but here, they were just starting out.

“Great Peak Master?”

Feng Yu sneakily glanced at the Great Peak Master.

“Having forsaken the Shisan Peak Master and chosen the Great Peak Master, maybe I will be treated differently?” Feng Yu thought secretly, a glimmer of hope rising in his heart.

However, to Feng Yu’s disappointment, the Great Peak Master didn’t give him an extra glance from start to finish. After listening to the Great Peak Master’s instructions, he was led out with the other challengers.

“No special treatment?”

Feng Yu felt dejected.

“No matter. The Great Peak Master is an Eighth Layer Evolver; there will be many more days ahead.”

“Definitely better than choosing the Shisan Peak Master.”

Feng Yu comforted himself.

…

Thirteenth Mountain Virtual World.

Mo Li and Wu Lan entered the grand hall with nervousness, and upon seeing Lin Yuan, they respectfully saluted, “Greetings, Peak Master.”

Lin Yuan sat in the high seat, looking down at these two young challengers.

One was eighty-seven, the other sixty-nine.

Those Evolvers who participated in the tournament were all under a hundred years old, many being ninety-eight or ninety-nine, hoping to seize the last chance to make a break.

Although Lin Yuan was younger than these two challengers, with the years spent traveling through worlds, his true age was much older.

“Thirteenth Mountain doesn’t have many people; since you’ve been chosen by me, you are now people of the Thirteenth Mountain,” Lin Yuan said, looking at them.

“Yes.”

Mo Li and Wu Lan were invigorated and hurriedly responded.

Especially Wu Lan, who originally hadn’t thought that, as a Silver Pattern Challenger, she would be directly chosen by a Peak Master, let alone the greatly renowned Shisan Peak Master.

“Just joined the Thirteenth Mountain, I will give you some guidance.”

Lin Yuan looked at Mo Li and said, “Mo Li, you have condensed a ‘Fighting Spirit,’ and have a talent in combat… Don’t resist.”

“Okay.”

Upon hearing this, Mo Li immediately let down all defenses.

Hum.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness immediately began to probe into Mo Li’s physical body.

Although Mo Li’s body here was not his true body, the Virtual World’s complete replication made it virtually no different from the true body.

Lin Yuan observed Mo Li’s physical soul carefully, and based on Mo Li’s forte in ‘combat,’ he began to ponder.

[Your perception defies heaven, comprehending the unknown physical soul and conceiving the corresponding Evolution Secret Technique…]

In just over a dozen breaths, an Evolution Secret Technique completely suitable for Mo Li was created by Lin Yuan.

This Evolution Secret Technique, specifically tailored for Mo Li, might be ineffective for other Evolvers to practice, but for Mo Li, it was a guiding light for the current and even future stages.

It could correct the path Mo Li was on and even allow him to go further in the future.

Lin Yuan withdrew his consciousness, looking at Mo Li.

“Peak Master?”

Mo Li opened his eyes, somewhat anxiously asked.

“I have a secret technique that suits you well…”
